title: Strategic slice roadmap and feedback-loop for Q2 Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Ava Chen
description: Define a lightweight, measurable quarterly 'strategic slice' for Hosted API + Model Catalog that accelerates feedback from production customers into the roadmap and OKR cadence. This ticket scopes a single cross-functional slice (one endpoint family, one quantized model variant, and two representative tenant cohorts) to validate rollout choreography, telemetry signals, and canary-to-production decision criteria. Outcomes: a repeatable playbook for future quarters, three critical dashboard widgets, and an automated alerting pattern tied to quality regressions and cost-per-token anomalies.
acceptance_criteria: Slice definition documented with selection rationale for endpoint, model variant, and cohorts
Runbook describing canary window, rollback criteria, and fallback model mapping
Telemetry dashboard with latency, P95, cost-per-token, and eval-quality trendlines for the slice
Automated regression alerts wired to on-call and product dashboard (thresholds agreed)
Two stakeholder review sessions held (SRE/Eng + CS/Customer Success) and signoff recorded
comments: 2026-03-02 - Ava Chen: Kickoff with SRE and Runtime leads; scoped cohorts (startup free-tier + mid-market API customers). Captured initial telemetry event list and retention needs. Confluence: /confluence/redwood/roadmaps/strategic-slice-q2
2026-03-04 - Diego Martinez: Prioritized three dashboard widgets: slice P95 latency, regression rate vs baseline, and cost-per-1000-tokens. Filed ENG work to add new metric tags (ENG-1999).
2026-03-06 - Priya Nair (SRE): Proposed canary window 72h with sliding threshold on 10k requests. Raised dependency on dedupe-traffic feature (ENG-2067).

2026-03-08 - Diego Martinez: Drafted runbook; added explicit fallback mapping to smaller quantized variant and region failover policy. Link to draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmaps/pull/142

2026-03-10 - Product review: Decided acceptance thresholds: regression >5% triggers rollback; cost spike >30% triggers safety-mode (rate-limit + cache-only). Action: schedule CS sync week of 2026-03-15.
notes: This slice emphasizes feedback loops over feature breadth: we will instrument user-facing metrics and human-in-the-loop eval feedback from two pilot customers.
Keep the slice small so runtime experiments (batching tweaks, KV caching parameters) can be A/B tested without fleet-wide risk.
We expect to capture at least two actionable product adjustments (prompt template, model quantization setting, or routing rule) by quarter end.
